notes.title: Option to disable bots in Offline Mode

items.text: The player can turn bot companions on or off in the raid setup.
The player will be automatically resurrected.
Resurrection Altars are disabled.
Ammo and health shards respawn over time.
Alternative fire energy restoration is increased.
Shredder's cooldown time is decreased.
Altar of Plenty can be activated by a single player.
The difficulty level of combat and objectives is adjusted for solo gameplay.
All secrets are open and available for exploration.
Ping system and Command Wheel are disabled.
Option to disable combo points on the HUD – points are still calculated, but not displayed.
PS5 - Improved performance during the fight with Orion of the Bloodswarm.
Fixed an issue where the microphone did not work in some cases for devices with invalid characters.
Fixed an issue where the aim assist option could remain active after being disabled in some cases.
Fixed inactive health shards dropped by Orion of the Bloodswarm (1st Biome boss).
Fixed an issue where the initial settings screen could be blocked in some cases.
Offline mode – Fixed Runner damage range.
Added missing "Breakneck Trail" codex illustration.
PC – Fixed disappearing UI highlight in the Settings menu in some cases.
PS5 - Fixed an issue where offline progression could be overwritten by online progression if the player started offline mode after signing out.

The Metal as Hell update has arrived, and the halls of Purgatory are about to ring out with the sweet sounds of slaughter. Step forward, Champion, and embrace your fury. Let every foul enemy feel the crushing chorus of their destruction! Listen, do you hear? The first notes have already been struck. It begins with…
The crucible gets ever more fearsome as new challenges enter the fray:
10 additional arenas have been added to the pool
One additional Boss, "Anak The Soulbinder" has been added to the pool.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549249/7a3275231f2b749c89d235c986ad1b3cd7d33e2e.gif"]

A strange artifact bursting with the blood of demons. Use this item to unleash three vials and seize one to harness the power of demonic essence. Empowered, your attacks will strike with doubled brutality, each kill siphoning a small surge of stolen life back into your veins.
Power this raw was never meant for mortals.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549249/0ede220bda31f8d1011fa820fd92daf914d2e0ff.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549249/72680f2e65227bf57e97c6d98b323c4505bdd500.gif"]

Behold: the Holy Orb Turret, a floating sphere cloaked in the tortured faces of the judged. When activated, the Orb's celestial wrath stirs to life, and searing white beams erupt forth in a merciless rotation. Anything caught within its radiant sweep will be annihilated.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549249/bcf67b6788e083fe2a219777566e543bd2e20b47.gif"]
Added a visual progress bar to character revivals.
Added a push-to-talk voice chat option.
Added 'Screen Space Shadows' setting to the graphics settings.

Improvements in the way "hook" points are displayed.
Improvements to weapon sound and visual effects.
Fixed issues with weapon swapping.
Fixed an issue where player input could be blocked after switching to/from the shredder.
Network optimizations.
Other minor bug fixes.
Improved weapon visual effects.
Improved Unholy Frag & Sticky Grenade visual effects.
Fixed an issue where the Sticky Grenade may not stick correctly.
Other minor bug fixes.
Improved the collision behaviour of thrown objects, such as explosive barrels and Blood Tanks.
Improved gore effects on enemies.

Improved the Combo Panel: each subsequent kill of a certain type will now also reflect how many times that kill type has been performed within the combo.
Added an option in Settings to turn off narrative voice-overs.
All button prompts now have the option to be activated by mouse click.

Fixed an issue where achievements could not be tracked properly if the game was force-quit.
Fixed an issue where players selecting Quick Play could encounter an error.
Fixed various issues that may occur if the player was attempting to join or re-join matches of either raids or Rogue Angel mode.
Fixed an issue where Roch couldn't be revived in the Prologue level.
Fixed an issue with French language localization in the Prologue level. tutorial
Fixed an issue where the Blood Tank could fall beneath the terrain.
Fixed an issue where bots could get stuck in a secret area within the Death Quarry level.
Fixed an issue where there was missing ambient audio in the Winding Canyons level.
Fixed an issue where enemies could assume the default model skeleton pose (A-Pose) upon death.
Fixed an issue where players could appear to have duplicate characters after loading into a raid.
Fixed an issue where the player may be unable to change their weapon properly upon defeating an Elite enemy.
Fixed an issue where the codex entries for Roch, Sol, and Runner would not unlock correctly.
Fixed multiple collision issues on boss and elite enemy models.
General performance improvements.
Track your path through Purgatory. Each location now has its own leaderboard, ranked by the score earned during a raid.
Accessible directly from the Lobby.
Leaderboards are platform-specific.
The communication wheel mouse navigation has been reduced to improve feel.
Reduced the frequency of in-mission voice lines.
Dialogue timing adjusted to occur less often during combat.
Certain voice-over variants now have a much lower chance to play.
Added a setting to switch the active display monitor.
Added sound effects for reward windows.
"Hunter’s Due" and "Hellborn’s Gift" descriptions now properly reflect their in-game functionality.
Added more accurate error messages when experiencing issues joining raids.
Achievements
Fixed an issue where the "Shred on Arrival" achievement would not progress correctly.
Fixed several of the most common crashes.
Gameplay Fixes
Fixed incorrect enemy spawns, missing enviro collisions, and movement bugs
Fixed an issue where Orion of the Bloodswarm's (first boss) collider would not despawn properly.
Fixed an issue where Blood Tanks had incorrect collision.
Fixed an issue where Static Blood Tanks could have incorrect inactive tank markers.
Fixed an issue where Soul Cages could behave incorrectly when being held during fast player movement.
Fixed an issue where bots could spawn outside the arena on Winding Canyons.
Fixed an issue with bot possession after player death in Rogue Angel mode.
Localization
Fixed missing French localizations of tutorial elements in the Prologue.
Offline Mode
Fixed an issue where Ancient Soul rewards could be counted incorrectly upon successful completion of a raid.
UI Fixes
Fixed an issue where the Sharpness option was missing a description.
Fixed an issue with player markers displaying incorrectly.
Fixed an issue where the Raid Summary screen incorrectly displayed character visuals.
User Experience
Fixed an issue where quickly pressing the middle mouse button during the tagging tutorial could block the alt-shot input.
Voice Chat
Fixed an issue where communication settings would not save unless the game was restarted.
Visuals & Effects
Fixed an issue where the Electrodriver’s alt-fire electricity effect was missing in the Prologue.
Fixed an issue where unintended world effects and visual interference could appear on the Character and Weapon selection screens.
Fixed an issue where the pressure plate platform in Canyons would visually twitch or glitch.

items.text: While you've been busy keeping the horde at bay, we've been squashing bugs. Demons are absolutely crawling with them, but we've managed to kill a few of the bigger ones before they spread any further:
Fixed an issue that caused some players to experience stuttering.
Fixed an issue that caused the Electrodriver's lightning attack to not be visible when encountering the Taurus while in the Prologue.
Fixed an issue where weapon upgrades that appeared to be equipped would not be.
Fixed an issue where if the player unlocked an upgrade in an upgrade path that they currently did not have selected, that upgrade would be highlighted.
Added the ability to rebind mouse buttons.
Added the ability to rebind all keys, with the exception of ESC.
That should help you focus on blasting those unholy vermin. If you have feedback on the demo so far, let us know about it in this thread.
If you run into any more bugs, issues (or god forbid, rogue demons), please file a ticket with our support meatbags here.
